title: User behavior funnel data lacks cleaning step
description: The user behavior analysis report contains significant duplicate event records and timestamp anomalies in the raw event log, causing distorted funnel metrics at each stage.

title: Multi-channel ad performance missing normalization
description: Ad spend volumes vary enormously across channels; without normalization the conversion rate comparisons are biased. Please normalize and produce a comparable report.

title: New user activation aggregated metrics not updated
description: New user activation data is spread across three channels; it needs to be aggregated by campaign dimension and published as a unified activation rate report.

title: Request: purchase additional BI tool licenses
description: Current BI tool licenses are expiring; the team needs to renew or procure a replacement. This is a procurement matter, not a data analysis issue.
